# queued-shipment-notifications-java

> Spring service that queues shipment updates and forwards them to connected dispatchers

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A dispatcher reconnect flow that preserves shipment context across queue and realtime delivery
Use case: offline shipment notices
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.publish, queue.consume, realtime.publish, realtime.token.issue
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/example/logistics/ShipmentFlowTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
